ordered_by: ezek_controlling_rulings_a1#e11 ruling GATE-E11 (the pre-primaries batch runs every CWO coverage report over v7)
why: both coverage tools enumerate their stages; neither knew v7, so CWO-EZ-19..23 could not be verified over rows_v7_cwo24
change: stage v7 added to the docstring, usage, choices, OUT_DIRS and the two stage-conditional tuples. No predicate, pattern, residual rule or output format changed.

regression.rule: each tool must RUN (exit 0) at stage v6 over the CHAIN HEAD and leave its live v6 reports byte for byte unchanged

a_vacuous_regression_was_caught_and_is_r.what_happened: the FIRST regression on _cwo_coverage_s2_ezek.py reported identical=true on all three reports and the patch was installed on it. It proved nothing. It invoked the candidate with the SUITE COPY of the rows (repair/suite_v6_6c843b14/rows.jsonl) while the live v6 reports name the CHAIN HEAD (repair/rows_v6_fixup3.jsonl). The tool aborted on the mismatch - 'exists with different content; never replaced' - wrote nothing, and the before/after digests were trivially equal.
a_vacuous_regression_was_caught_and_is_r.how_it_was_caught: the tool's stderr was read rather than only its digests; all three runs carried an ABORT
a_vacuous_regression_was_caught_and_is_r.what_was_done: the regression was re-run with the chain head against the INSTALLED tool and passed for the right reason (exit 0 and byte equality); the sibling patch was then written to assert exit 0 as well as byte equality, and fails closed if the tool refuses
a_vacuous_regression_was_caught_and_is_r.class: a check that passes because nothing happened; the same family as the campaign's coverage-statement-is-not-coverage rule
a_vacuous_regression_was_caught_and_is_r.shipped_impact: none: the patch it installed is independently confirmed correct by the corrected regression

s4_10_not_closed: S4-10 stands: _cwo_coverage_s2_ezek.py still has no --selftest, so the regression IS the discrimination. The receipt names the exact run path per S3-NOTES (1).

run_path.method: the live v6 reports were backed up to a temp directory, the candidate ran in place, digests were compared, and the backups would have been restored on any difference

dependency_applicability: v4, v5, v5cwo23 and v6 behaviour is unchanged and proven so by the regression. No ruling, row, claim or earlier receipt depends on the changed lines.
